title: Revision and snapshots
summary: Explicit refresh updates eligible admitted cases and their existing owner snapshot atomically, preserving targets, provenance, passed acceptance and capture history. Successful captures awaiting review can continue an inherited machine chain; independent judgment still follows complete capture. Item gate materialization keeps each attached plan snapshot stable across retries. For an explicit replacement, retain the failed case and add a distinct corrected key; when that key exists in the applicable current plan but not the snapshot, replacement_materialization_stale names the item, transition and project rematerialize command followed by the replacement declaration. Unknown keys, ambiguous cases and wrong obligation scope have separate diagnoses. Refresh updates matching rows, adds eligible cases and retires removed cases. Corrected code under the same case uses an ordinary retry without --replaces. Adding a case during a live walk refuses with the abort/retry command and rolls back the whole refresh. Post-deploy plans are never copied onto items, so refresh and rematerialize never apply to them; the next release tests an edited plan.
